mission01.label: Mission 01: Fordline
mission01.description: Secure the Ashford ford. You start with a construction yard, one tank, and enough credits for a power plant, refinery, and factory. Harvest the ore beside your yard, build a small force, and destroy the walled outpost across the river.

objectives.power: Build a Power Plant before the refinery so the base stays powered.
objectives.economy: Build an Ore Refinery and a Vehicle Factory, then produce a Harvester and gather the ore beside your yard.
objectives.fight: Cross the ford and destroy every enemy building. The outpost is walled, with an opening on the south side. Losing all of your buildings ends the mission.

demo.label: Demo
demo.description: Built-in battle on the current terrain. Two armies meet with tanks, aircraft, and ships beside cliffs, lakes, and a coast.
